text:
eli: heads-up: discovered a consumer-reported type regression when our TS SDK is used from an ESM edge function. generics on overloaded APIs collapse to any after publish.
jana: can you paste a tiny repro? this rings a bell (dts bundling).
eli: minimal SDK code:
```ts
// src/client.ts
export function resolve<T = { id: string }>(input: T): Promise<T>;
export function resolve(input: any) { return Promise.resolve(input); }
```
consumer (ESM app):
```ts
import { resolve } from 'redwood-inference-sdk';
const out = await resolve({ id: 'x' });
// expectation: out has type {id: string}; reality: any
```
ci-bot: build job `packages/sdk:build` reported: "dts-plugin: collapsed overloads into implementation signature".
frank: we've hit tsup's DTS bundler behavior before; it merges overloads and drops generic defaults which breaks inference for downstream ESM consumers.
eli: local `tsc` compile on the repo shows correct types, but npm package contains a single `index.d.ts` with a broad signature.
jana: fixes we've used: emit real .d.ts per-file (tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -> dist/types) then run tsup for JS only. or add a handwritten `index.d.ts` that preserves overloads.
frank: prefer the tsc emit approach. workflow: run `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist/types`, then tsup with `--dts false`. ensure package.json `types` points to `dist/types/index.d.ts`.
ops-bot: created ticket #4342 "SDK: preserve overload generics for ESM consumers by emitting per-file d.ts" assigned to jana.
eli: can we add an examples/edge-typing-check that installs the built package and runs `tsc --noEmit` with `moduleResolution: 'bundler'`? that should catch regressions in CI.
jana: yes. I'll add the smoke test in CI (matrix: Node 20, TS 5.x, bundler resolution). also add docs note about `moduleResolution` differences and `types` resolution quirks on some bundlers.
frank: small follow-up: check `exports` field too; some bundlers ignore conditional `types` in exports so top-level `types` is still useful.
eli: great, thanks all. I'll validate on a Vercel preview once PR lands and report any remaining edge cases.
